text: APPROVE. The extracted loop removes about 8 points of cognitive complexity from `BypassableInvariantEntities`, leaving it well under 15. The logic is identical (`Where(IsScalaType)` replaces the `continue` guard, evaluated eagerly in the same order), and `System.Linq` is already in use in the file, so the build should be unaffected. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build or run the tests.
